body: Private read-only pre-post review of committed branch b3f3c35 (not treating it as a candidate): F1 capacity and F2 typed/preflightable mixed-layer refusal are now implemented coherently; supportedDetails combines kind presence with per-token parent-chain coverage and avoids the vacuous empty-atlas bug. One stale blocker remains in that commit: atlas.scala:20/92 still adds VisualChannel.SurfaceRail, but owner disposition post-01M16Q0TKX4P477262B17S1CB0 explicitly supersedes it with KEEP VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit plus strengthened renderer-y wording. Please amend before posting the next SHA. Also retain the chief-required F1/F2 mutation runs; the committed tests are good positives, but no empty/no-token capacity test or exact-field negative fixture was added. Type-discipline static pass otherwise clean.
